notes: Matches the instruction set's own "The harvest begins in September" pattern exactly: Patient on the intransitive begin-subject, no tense atom (no TODAY and no lexically future adjunct, so the futurate rule cannot fire), and "sundown" as a bare day-part constant on Time.
